title: Power of search, seizure and arrest
shortTitle: Power of search, seizure and arrest
question: What does Ndlea Act section 25 say about power of search, seizure and arrest?
shortAnswer: Ndlea Act s.25 — NDLEA officers may: enter/search premises without warrant on reasonable suspicion; stop/search vehicles/vessels; arrest without warrant; seize drugs/precursors/conveyances; demand documents.
legalExplanation:
**Section 25 of the Ndlea Act** provides:

NDLEA officers may: enter/search premises without warrant on reasonable suspicion; stop/search vehicles/vessels; arrest without warrant; seize drugs/precursors/conveyances; demand documents

This provision empowers Ndlea Act officers with specific powers and duties.
